hero.title: Birthday Parties
hero.lede: A milestone birthday deserves a room full of the right people. Book a private table for a family dinner, or take our function suite for up to 120 with a meal, music and a bar for the evening. Ask about a late licence.

sections.title: A birthday at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
Eighteenth, twenty-first, fortieth, sixtieth or eightieth: the big birthdays are the ones where the whole family and the old friends turn up, some of them from a long way away. What the day needs is a room that fits the party, food that everyone will eat, somewhere to raise a glass, and beds nearby for the people who have travelled.

For a quiet celebration we lay a private table in the restaurant or the conservatory, where a family can sit down to dinner together and the cake arrives when you give the nod. For a party, our Back o’ Barns function suite holds up to 120 for a standing reception and seats 100 for dinner, and it is air-conditioned. Choose a sit-down meal or a buffet from our own kitchen, bring a DJ or a band if you’d like music, and let us run a bar for the evening. If you want the night to go on, ask us about a late licence when you book.

You’re welcome to dress the room with your own decorations; we’ll agree a time for setting up. And when the party is over, the birthday person and the guests who have come furthest can stay the night in one of our 18 en-suite rooms and have breakfast with us rather than driving home.

sections.title: The room, the food and the night after

items.title: A table or the whole suite
items.text: A private table in the restaurant or conservatory for a family dinner, or the Back o' Barns function suite for up to 120 standing and 100 seated, with space for music.

items.title: A meal or a buffet
items.text: A sit-down meal or a buffet from our own kitchen, agreed with you beforehand, and a bar for the evening; ask about a late licence. This season's menus are confirmed when you book.

items.title: Stay the night
items.text: Eighteen en-suite rooms in the hotel for the birthday person and the guests who have travelled, with a full Scottish breakfast cooked to order when it is part of the rate. Check-in is from 2pm, check-out by 11am.

sections.title: Birthday parties: what people ask us

items.q: How many people can the function suite take?
items.a: Up to 120 for a standing reception and 100 seated for dinner. For smaller numbers we’d suggest a private table in the restaurant or the conservatory instead, which feels more like a dinner than a function.

items.q: Can we have music, and how late can the party go?
items.a: Yes, you can bring a DJ or a band for the function suite; tell us what you have in mind when you book. The bar runs through the evening, and if you’d like the party to go on later, ask us about a late licence.

items.q: Can we bring a cake and decorations?
items.a: Yes to both. Bring the cake and we’ll set it out with a stand and a knife and bring it in when you say. Decorations are welcome too; we’ll agree a time for you to dress the room beforehand.

items.q: Do we need to pay a deposit?
items.a: We may ask for a deposit to hold the room and the date. We’ll explain how much, when it is due and our cancellation terms when you book, and confirm the menu and this season’s prices at the same time.

sections.title: Plan the birthday
sections.text: Tell us the date, the number of guests and whether you’d like a dinner or a party, and we’ll come back with what we can do.
